evidence_quotes.quote: The objective of this study was to inform Solomon Water of potential service delivery models for the expansion of water and sanitation services in informal settlements in Honiara.
As described below, many of do not result in safe and affordable drinking and domestic water.
with input from Solomon Water, informal settlement residents and other stakeholders, together with analytical information and lessons about service delivery models used elsewhere

raw_response.plain_vs_narrow_note: Under the literal/plain Criterion 2 wording, institutional utility service-delivery models for informal settlements (Solomon Water) clearly engage institutional/administrative governance factors (c2_legal_admin_plain = yes), whereas under the 2026-10-13 narrow rule-type reading it is unclear from the abstract alone whether tenure/documentation rules, tariff/subsidy structures, or regulatory mandates are specifically analysed (c2_legal_admin_narrow = unclear). Under both readings, the Phase 5 decision is 'unsure' because full-text retrieval is needed to verify empirical primary data collection (c3) and specific legal/regulatory/tariff mechanisms in informal settlements.
raw_response.rationale: The study examines water and sanitation service access, safety, and affordability for residents of informal settlements in Honiara served or targeted by the public utility Solomon Water (c1 = yes, c4 = yes). Utility service expansion into informal settlements plausibly examines tenure/documentation barriers, tariff/affordability rules, or utility regulatory mandates under the narrow Criterion 2 reading (c2_legal_admin_narrow = unclear), and clearly involves institutional service-delivery governance under the plain reading (c2_legal_admin_plain = yes). Because the abstract notes 'input from Solomon Water, informal settlement residents and other stakeholders, together with analytical information' without detailing whether systematic primary empirical research is reported versus a policy options consultancy assessment (c3 = unclear), full-text review is required ('unsure').
